title.value: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Precise Soccer Shooting Skills using a Quadrupedal Robot
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Precise Soccer Shooting Skills using a Quadrupedal Robot

extractions.description: This paper presents a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework for enabling quadrupedal robots to perform precise soccer shooting skills in the real world. The framework combines robot motion control and planning into one task, considering dynamics limitations, motion stability, and uncertainties associated with the ball and ground.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper is focused on robotics and control algorithms, not directly on sustainable development.

using reinforcement learning.
